guestDesire.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How much desire does the ad create in the guest it is written for?

decisionUsefulness.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How useful is it for the guest's decision (what they get, why it matters, what to do next)?

propertyAndPlaceSpecificity.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How specific is it to this property and this place, rather than any luxury hotel?

audienceResonance.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How well does it resonate with the target guest, without persona labels or over-literal use of research?

wholeAssetCoherence.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How coherent is the whole ad: do the texts, headlines and description work together as one idea?

editorialRhythm.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How good is the editorial rhythm: sentence length, flow, no text walls?

nonRepetition.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How free is it of repetition across texts and headlines (openings, phrases, images)?

memorableBrandVoice.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How memorable and on-brand is the voice?

channelFitness.instructions: Judge the candidate ad as a guest-first editor. How well does it fit a Meta ad: scroll-stopping first line, headline compatible with every text, clear call to action?

publishReady.instructions: Could this ad be published as it is, with no hard blocker (misleading offer, invented fact, broken or truncated field, explicit brief violation)?

criteria.false: Has at least one hard blocker
